title.hr: Vrste IPv6 adresa i njihov domet
title.en: IPv6 address types and their reach

concept.hr: Link-local, GUA, ULA i multicast: prefiks određuje vrstu, vrsta domet
concept.en: Link-local, GUA, ULA and multicast: the prefix sets the type, the type the reach

summary.hr: Upiši IPv6 adresu: najdulji prefiks koji se poklapa daje vrstu, a slika pokazuje dokle paket stiže. Bitovi, ne znamenke.
summary.en: Type an IPv6 address: the longest matching prefix gives its type, and the picture shows how far a packet goes. Bits, not digits.
